decisions.reason: The combined shuttering and de-shuttering robot took over the function of the withdrawn standalone de-shuttering robot and builds directly on the firm's automation and formwork expertise, so its own R&D can keep refining it.
The profile storage robot complements the shuttering robots and uses the firm's material-handling and control know-how, and its integration value within automated lines justifies keeping it.
Automatic shuttering is core to the firm's automated precast offer, though some overlap with the combined robot adds modest risk of consolidation, as happened with the de-shuttering robot.
The newly launched multi-model cleaning and plotting line builds on established pallet-circulation know-how and needs time for the firm to assimilate early customer feedback.
The production analysis software uses the firm's in-house control and planning capabilities and generates data that strengthens learning across its machinery portfolio.
